name: WorkMate.Demo.Zenith.Legacy
displayName: TEST FIXTURE: the Zenith recipe as it stood before slices F1 and F2
$fixtureNotes: NOT A SHIPPED RECIPE. This is the Zenith demo file as it was at commit ae091d3b8, before slice F1 added aliases and slice F2 added authored plurals and menu orders — taken from git rather than written here, so it is the file those tenants were actually built from and not somebody's recollection of it.

It exists to reproduce a REAL tenant reported from manual testing, where re-applying the current Zenith recipe failed on every dimension type at once: menuOrder 0 in the tenant against 10, 20, 40 and 50 in the recipe, and allowsSelfNesting True against False on Department and Team.

allowsSelfNesting is TRUE here for Department and Team, and that is the one place this fixture departs from what git holds — every shipped version of the file said false. Nothing in the repository can account for the tenant's True: no migration writes the flag, and the only other writer is the Dimension types screen, which offered a self-nesting checkbox until ADR-0010's addendum removed it. So it is set here to match the tenant that was reported rather than the file that was shipped, because the tenant is what the fix has to work on.
Keep it frozen. Editing it to match whatever the current recipe says would turn the test that uses it into a test that the current recipe matches itself.
description: TEST DATA — a project-based engineering contractor, as a worked example of two kinds of unit at one level. Under a Division sits either a Department or a Project, and a Project contains Teams; nothing else is permitted. Self-contained: every code is prefixed zenith-, so it adds to a tenant without colliding with the other demo recipes and can be applied in any order alongside them.
author: Aramis Enterprise Solutions
$notes: The shape this exists to demonstrate: Department and Project are siblings under a Division, not one above the other. Before ADR-0010 that was inexpressible — the only way to allow a Project under a Division was to turn on level skipping, which also allowed a Team under one.
Stated as rootTypeCodes + containment, never allowSkipLevel. The two are different descriptions of the same thing and the structures step refuses a row that gives both.
Project carries a real attribute schema — start date, end date, cost code, site location — and the records carry values for it. Both halves travel through export and import since ADR-0011.

Headcounts are deliberately absent: employees do not exist until prompt 4. The figures to seed are recorded in the prompt library's prompt 4 backlog note, alongside the matrix assignment this organisation is the example for.

structures.$containmentNote: The two self-pairs are the point of this fixture. A tenant built when Department and Team carried allowsSelfNesting: true has department > department and team > team in its map — StructureContainmentDerivation.FromChain adds a self-pair for every type that declares the flag, and Migrations.UpdateFrom4Async ran that derivation over structures that had no explicit map. No current recipe restates them, so any row that describes zenith-org in full is refused on them. That is the failure this fixture reproduces, and the reason the positions recipe uses the additive form instead.
